subject: history
concept: Reading and interpreting historical maps showing change over time (territorial changes, trade routes, migrations)
source_inspiration: original content, building on P2 map skills — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student overlays two historical maps of the same region from different time periods and identifies changes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a map change to the historical event that likely caused it
exercise.abstract: Student explains what a described historical map reveals about change over time

misconception_flags: describes what a map shows without connecting it to any historical cause of the change

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
